messages:
Amy (Sales): Hey team — FinchFinance wants a lightweight POC next week. Goal: SDK-based streaming to our hosted endpoint with webhook callbacks for structured outputs. Main asks: SSE vs websocket, auth with short-lived creds, sample structured schema, and very rough pricing for ~10k messages/day. @sam_se can you support?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Yep. Quick q: is the POC on Redwood hosted or do they want an on-prem connector? Hosted is much faster to spin up and supports ephemeral keys + SSE out of the box.
Jordan (Finch): Hosted would be preferred for speed. We have a dev k8s cluster but want minimal infra changes.
Sam (Solutions Eng): OK hosted then. SSE is simplest for one-way stream -> webhook pattern. Websockets if they need two-way low-latency interaction. Auth: use ephemeral API keys + short ttl (we can mint via OAuth flow or our presales token service).
Sam (Solutions Eng): Sample SSE client (node):
```js
const es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-3');
es.onmessage = e => console.log(JSON.parse(e.data));
```
Sam (Solutions Eng): For structured output we recommend streaming newline-delimited JSON objects with a small envelope: {"type":"chunk","payload":{"json":{...},"score":0.98}}. If you need function/tool-calls, stream the call-candidate and then send a single tool-invoke request.
Amy (Sales): Pricing ask: rough hosted delta for 10k messages/day, avg 300 tokens per message (prompt+response). Ballpark monthly?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Very rough: at hosted rates that's ~3M tokens/month. Depending on model family: 3M * hosted rate. Expect $X–$Y/month (I'll pull exact numbers). If they want predictable unit costs we can show Dedicated reserved capacity quotes — that requires sales but typically gives 30–50% discount for commit.
Lia (Security): Quick security notes: need to confirm data residency, SOC2 attestation, and whether customer requires KMS/HSM. For hosted POC we can offer encryption at rest + TDE, but if they need customer-managed keys we need Private deployment or Dedicated with KMS integration.
Jordan (Finch): We need SOC2 and EU data residency. Also customer wants SSO for admin console.
Sam (Solutions Eng): SOC2 link: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2 (send formal doc once I pull it). For EU residency we can pin region; ephemeral keys + IP allowlist for the POC. SSO is supported via SAML/Okta for admin console.
infra-bot: quote-service: created reserved-capacity-req #Q-712 (sales ops)
Tom (PM): Runbook suggestion for the POC: 1) create ephemeral token endpoint 2) sample SSE client + webhook stub 3) structured schema + validation tests 4) acceptance criteria: 99th perc latency < 500ms and structured parse accuracy > 95% on sample set.
Sam (Solutions Eng): For function/tool calling in-stream: two patterns — stream call candidates (lightweight) or do a single sync tool call after stream completes. If they want streaming tool outputs we can demo with our callbacks + signing.
Amy (Sales): Jordan — can you share your minimal schema example? We can adapt ours to match.
Jordan (Finch): attaching quick schema in next msg.
Jordan (Finch): {"transactionId":"string","intent":"string","entities":[{"type":"string","value":"string"}],"confidence":0.0} (that should be fine)
Sam (Solutions Eng): Great — we'll wire that into the sample client and show streaming NDJSON with small envelope. Also will add example for validating incoming webhooks.
Lia (Security): I'll start filling security questionnaire items. Amy, please share customer contact and expected PO timeline.
Amy (Sales): Contact is jordan@finch.co. They want a demo by next Tue, 2-week POC window after approval. Also asked about a short Dedicated trial — can sales ops accommodate a 2-week eval?
Tom (PM): We can do a short eval on Dedicated but need a formal request. Sales ops/finance signoff required. For the demo we can show canary fallback to a smaller model to illustrate graceful degradation.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare: - sample Node & Go clients - SSE webhook stub + validation - structured schema examples - pricing ballpark + dedicated trial ask to sales ops. Meeting to sync Thu 10am?
Amy (Sales): Thu 10am works for Finch and us. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Jordan (Finch): Thanks! Looking forward to the kit and the demo.
Amy (Sales): Next steps: Sam to draft repo + runbook, Lia to start questionnaire, Amy to coordinate trial request with sales ops.
